I used this with the corresponding face serum for 3 weeks and it caused a major breakout of deep painful acne all over my face. When I quit using it, my skin rapidly healed and has been fine since. I don't know what ingredient caused this (maybe the high concentration of niacinamide?) but this product isn't for me. It did lighten hyperigmentation but didn't improve melasma.

As a neurodivergent, I flock to products that deliver, deliver quickly, can accomplish several jobs at once, and don't leave me wanting to wipe it all off to escape the feeling once I'm done. It's rough out here lol, especially with darker, sensitive skin bc so much just isn't formulated to work as well for us, whether you're consistent or not. But this? Unicorns are real, y'all. I use it with the rest of the Mela B3 line, but this cleanser is a standout on its own. Yk how sometimes you wipe toner over your face and dead skin gets on the cotton pad? NOT ANYMORE. It's fading dark spots I though were gonna outlive me, and I haven't even been using it all everyday. I'm glowing after just CLEANSER, and I don't have to put up with tight skin for it! T•T And it plays well with my other products, too! I bought the whole B3 line on impulse and am keeping everything. Prepare to be SICKA ME!! More and more brands are remembering us black and brown skin girlies while they cook in the lab. And La Roche-Posay has gone above and beyond with cute, purple packaging to match. Stuff like this makes it easier for people like me to maintain and genuinely get excited about self care. I never would've thought this is how good things could get.

avis.titre: Works wonders but dries your face
avis.texte: I bought this cleanser as a substitute for the serum version as it was more affordable and somehow the cleanser managed to not only lighten my dark spots but my face overall. I have never seen my face this cleared up from acne and I have extremely stubborn skin. The biggest concern I have about this product is that its super drying. It has dried my face to the extent where some parts experience peeling/flaking. Due to this, I had to use extra moisturizer or hydrating products as the product can cause redness as well. A little goes a long way, make sure not to use too much otherwise your skin will be harmed rather than healed.
I just bought it, been using it for a week consistently and i already see results! I am obsessed & it smells soo good!

This has lightened up dark spots due tl sun as well as almost completely reduced a small mole that needed checking. I was using the serum as well, so that could attribute to that. Still, skin felt soft and smooth after washing face.

I used this and corresponding melasyl serum daily for approximately 3 weeks before having one of the worst breakouts of my life. My face erupted in cytsic acne. As soon as I quit using these products, my skin rapidly healed. I have used niacinamide before but not at this high of concentration. Not sure if it's that or some other ingredient that aggravated my skin. It did not reduce my skin sebum at all nor help with mild melasama, but it did somewhat help reduce other hyperpigmentation and surface redness. It cleaned the skin well without drying it, so I liked it at first and had high hopes. Obviously not a product for me though.

I got this less for evening skintone, but more for gentle exfoliation. I have pretty congested skin with a very oily tzone but dry elsewhere. Very much recommend if your skin sounds like mine.

avis.titre: Impressive Brightening and Smoothing Results in Just One ...
avis.texte: After using the La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser with Melasyl for just one week, I am thoroughly impressed with the results. La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Clarifying Unifying Micro-Peeling Gel is a noteworthy product for improving uneven skin tone and dark spots. With its lightweight and easily absorbed gel texture, it provides a refreshing and clean feeling after use. This gel contains B3 (Niacinamide), which helps brighten and even out skin tone, along with micro-exfoliating particles that gently remove dead skin cells, promoting skin regeneration. Over time, you may notice smoother skin and a significant reduction in dark spots. The product is also suitable for sensitive skin due to its gentle, non-irritating formula. For those with oily or acne-prone skin, this gel helps deep clean pores and reduce the formation of acne. In summary, La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Clarifying Unifying Micro-Peeling Gel is an excellent choice for those looking to improve uneven skin tone and achieve deep cleansing. However, as with any skincare product, consistent use and a proper skincare routine will yield the best results.

avis.titre: Achieve Clear, Even Skin: A Review of La Roche-Posay Mela...
avis.texte: I recently started using the La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser with Melasyl and have had a positive experience so far. **Effectiveness:** The cleanser effectively removes impurities, makeup, and excess oil without stripping my skin. I noticed an improvement in my skin's overall clarity and a reduction in the appearance of dark spots after a few weeks of consistent use. **Price:** While the price is on the higher end compared to other cleansers, I believe it's worth the investment given the quality and effectiveness of the product. You get what you pay for, and in this case, it's a high-quality cleanser that delivers visible results. **Packaging:** The packaging is simple yet functional. The pump dispenser is convenient and hygienic, allowing for easy and controlled use. The bottle is sturdy and attractive, fitting well on my bathroom shelf. **Ingredients:** The inclusion of Melasyl, along with niacinamide (vitamin B3) and other beneficial ingredients, sets this cleanser apart. It's formulated to target pigmentation issues and improve skin tone, making it suitable for those dealing with dark spots and uneven skin. Overall, the La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser with Melasyl has become a valuable part of my skincare routine. Its effectiveness, thoughtful packaging, and high-quality ingredients justify the price, making it a product I highly recommend for anyone looking to improve their skin's appearance and health.

avis.texte: The Mela B3 Cleanser by La Roche-Posay is highly effective in gently cleansing the skin and addressing hyperpigmentation concerns. It has a subtle, refreshing scent and a creamy texture that feels luxurious on the skin. The packaging is practical and easy to use, with a convenient pump dispenser. While it may be slightly more expensive than some cleansers, its efficacy and skin-loving ingredients make it a worthwhile investment for those prioritizing skincare results. Overall, it offers excellent value for money considering its effectiveness and quality.

My face has many dark spots and scars from years of trauma. After using this for a month, My skin is clearing up better than ever. My scars are disappearing and new skin is turning. I'm so happy with this

I love this cleanser so much! A little goes a long way and the after feel is amazing! Leaves my face super soft and clean without any irritation. I have started seeing a more even tone on my face too!
I've been using this in conjunction with the mela b3 serum and they work well together! My dark spots have faded but my skin is a bit dry. I just use extra oils to combat it though.

After using this cleanser for a week, I'm definitely adding this to my rotation. It gets my face squeaky clean but it's gentle on my skin without making it feel striped, dry or irritated. It is a gel consistency that lathers into a nice foam and has a floral/herbal type of scent that's not overwhelming. Since using this I have noticed that my pores look minimized. This might be my new favorite cleanser.
This cleanser is amazing! I use it daily after I clean my makeup and it cleans well. I will definitely buy it again. You can feel the texture of the cleanser and how it makes lighter your skin.

I have been using the Mela B3 cleanser with Melasyl for over a week. You don't need very much at a time to use on your face and it feels good on skin in my opinion. I have noticed how much better my skin looks since using this. I definitely recommend this product to my friends and family.

After using the Mela B3 Cleanser with Melasyl for one week, I am pleased with the results and impressed by its performance. This cleanser has a gentle yet effective formula that left my skin feeling clean and refreshed without any tightness or dryness. The inclusion of Melasyl seems to be a beneficial addition, as my complexion appears brighter and more even-toned than before. Overall, I would highly recommend the Mela B3 Cleanser with Melasyl to anyone looking for a reliable.
This cleanser is so nice on the skin. It gives a clean feeling with out drying the skin. The bottle is easy to use. It's gentle and skin feels so smooth.
This product is amazing easy on the skin. Doesn't dry out your skin and make you feel like a snake. There is a light scent, but doesn't seem to irritate my skin. ￼

This gel cleanser evens skin tone and targets hyperpigmentation effectively. It does not have a scent and is made with good ingredients. The packaging is user friendly. The cleanser is fairly priced for the quality of the product.

But I think it's definitely worth it because it really does help and it doesn't leave your skin flaky afterwards just nice because product similar to this have in the past left my skin super flaky after ￼￼

This is a huge bottle, worth the price. The gel cleanser left my skin very clean but not too clean to the point where it feels dry afterwards. Although this cleanser has niacinamide, I think the serum is much faster at treating discoloration. This star ingredient of this is PHA, so if you want treatment for discoloration, I suggest using it with the serum.
My acne scars and hyperpigmentation are fading. Even my melasma under my eyes has lightened. This product is a must have. Great value and effective.
